title: Move cross-origin opener policy into policy container

labels.name: topic: cross-origin-opener-policy
labels.description: Issues and ideas around the new "inverse of rel=noopener" header

body: This PR does two things: - Introduces policy container's cross-origin opener policy member - Removes the two members that are redundant with it: - `Document`'s [cross-origin opener policy member](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/C#concept-document-coop) - navigation params's [cross-origin opener policy member](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/C#navigation-params-coop) This change is mostly mechanical with a few exceptions: - In the current spec's [#creating-a-new-browsing-context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/C#creating-a-new-browsing-context) > Step 15, we clone the creator Document's policy container and then [_conditionally inherit_ the cross-origin opener policy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#creating-browsing-contexts:concept-document-coop) based on same-origin-ness. After this PR, we continue to inherit the policy container, and the _conditionally censor_ the policy container's cross-origin opener policy based on _cross-origin-ness_ - The about:srcdoc navigation case ([specific diff](https://whatpr.org/html/9149/1279623...b01765b/browsing-the-web.html#create-navigation-params-from-a-srcdoc-resource)), where we always navigate with a blank COOP. Before this PR, in order to achieve this the spec just created a brand new cross-origin policy and passed that into navigation params. With this PR, by default the policy container (and therefore COOP) would be inherited from the parent. So in order to maintain the old behavior, this PR _manually_ resets the inherited policy container's COOP _back_ to "the brand new uninitialized COOP" (in step 7 of the "specific diff" link). I'm not sure if the old spec's behavior is exactly what we want, but either way this PR maintains it to be a pure clean-up. - In "create navigation params by fetching", we manually set the "determined" policy container's COOP to _responseCOOP_ so that it can be read later on when creating the new Document for the navigation. We used to put it on the navigation params but now we have to manually set it on the policy container that goes _into_ the navigation params. *** /browsers.html ( diff ) /browsing-the-web.html ( diff ) /document-lifecycle.html ( diff ) /document-sequences.html ( diff ) /dom.html ( diff )
